issues.source_quote: Сидячий? - Чего? - Сидит? - Кто? - Мужик этот твой! - Во деревня! Ну ты даешь! Кто же его посадит? Он же памятник!
issues.translation_quote: Was he inside? - Inside what? - Sitting inside? - Who? - Your man! Inside the statue! - What a bumpkin! You don't get it! How could he be inside? The man is the statue!
issues.justification: The joke plays on 'сидячий' (seated statue) versus 'сидеть' (be in prison / be put away). The translation invents 'inside the statue', which makes no sense and destroys the humor.

issues.source_quote: Нам не страшен серый волк... Я злой и страшный серый волк, я в поросятах знаю толк.
issues.translation_quote: We're not afraid of the big bad wolf, the big bad wolf... I'm the big bad wolf, a fearsome beast; on little piggies I love to feast!
issues.justification: Acceptable rhyme, but 'Только, знаешь, это страшнее' ('it's scarier') is mistranslated as 'he's scarier than that', changing meaning of the exchange; also 'Ненормальный пришел' softened to 'odd fellow'.

issues.translation_quote: Dinner is served! Please sit down and stuff your faces.
issues.justification: Acceptable, but 'Вам по 40 лет' / 'Ваших подопечных' etc. The humor of polite-yet-crude register is partly kept; minor.
